 "data": "classDiagram\nclass IFRM {\n<<interface>>\n+logBegin(txId) LSN\n+logChange(record) LSN\n+logCommit(txId) LSN\n+flushLogUntil(lsn) void\n+rollback(txId) RollbackResult\n+recover() RecoveryResult\n+checkpoint() CheckpointResult\n+restoreTo(target) RecoveryResult\n+readLog(txId) List~LogRecord~\n}\nclass FailureRecoveryManager {\n+logBegin(txId) LSN\n+logChange(record) LSN\n+logCommit(txId) LSN\n+flushLogUntil(lsn) void\n+rollback(txId) RollbackResult\n+recover() RecoveryResult\n+checkpoint() CheckpointResult\n+restoreTo(target) RecoveryResult\n+readLog(txId) List~LogRecord~\n}\nclass LogManager {\n-buffer List~LogRecord~\n+readLogFrom(lsn, direction) Iterator~LogRecord~\n-nextLSN() LSN\n-appendToBuffer(record) LSN\n-forceToDisk(lsn) void\n-serialize(record) bytes\n-deserialize(bytes) LogRecord\n}\nclass RecoveryManager {\n+rollback(txId) RollbackResult\n+recover() RecoveryResult\n+restoreTo(target) RecoveryResult\n-undoRecord(record) void\n-redoRecord(record) void\n-analyze(startLSN) TransactionStatusTable\n-createInitialSnapshot() SnapshotLocation\n}\nclass CheckpointManager {\n+checkpoint() CheckpointResult\n+findLastCheckpoint() LSN\n}\nclass FRMDriver {\n+runScenario(file) TestResult\n}\nclass StorageManager {\n<<external interface>>\n+fetchRecord(table, rid) Row\n+insertRecordAt(table, rid, row) status\n+updateRecord(table, rid, row) status\n+deleteRecord(table, rid) status\n+flushAll() status\n+createSnapshot() SnapshotLocation\n+loadSnapshot(location) status\n}\nclass ConcurrencyControlManager {\n<<external interface>>\n+blockNewTransactions() void\n+waitUntilNoActive(timeout) status\n+resumeTransactions() void\n}\nclass LogRecord {\n+LSN lsn\n+int txId\n+LogType type\n+String table\n+RID rid\n+Row before\n+Row after\n+long timestamp\n+LSN prevLSN\n}\nclass LogType {\n<<enumeration>>\nBEGIN\nINSERT\nUPDATE\nDELETE\nCOMMIT\nABORT\nCHECKPOINT_START\nCHECKPOINT_END\n}\nclass RollbackResult {\n+status\n+String message\n}\nclass RecoveryResult {\n+boolean success\n+int maxTxId\n+LSN lastLSN\n+List~int~ redoneTx\n+List~int~ undoneTx\n+String message\n}\nclass RecoveryTarget {\n+kind TIME_or_TX_ID\n+long time\n+int txId\n}\nclass CheckpointResult {\n+boolean success\n+LSN checkpointLSN\n+String message\n}\nclass FRMException {\n+code\n+String message\n}\nclass RID {\n<<owned by SM>>\n+int pageId\n+int slotId\n}\nclass Row {\n<<owned by SM>>\n+values\n}\nIFRM <|.. FailureRecoveryManager\nFailureRecoveryManager ..> LogManager : uses\nFailureRecoveryManager ..> RecoveryManager : uses\nFailureRecoveryManager ..> CheckpointManager : uses\nFRMDriver ..> IFRM : tests\nRecoveryManager ..> LogManager : reads\nRecoveryManager ..> StorageManager : undo and redo\nRecoveryManager ..> ConcurrencyControlManager : maintenance\nCheckpointManager ..> LogManager : force\nCheckpointManager ..> StorageManager : flushAll\nCheckpointManager ..> ConcurrencyControlManager : quiesce\nLogManager ..> LogRecord : stores\nLogRecord --> LogType\nLogRecord --> RID\nLogRecord --> Row\n",
